da-referee-verdict.referee_argument: The block wears keystone-discharge + theorem-level labels and a boxed 'this identification is a theorem', yet its lean.ref resolves under §0a (sibling-first) to a verbatim `theorem depth_2_identification : True := by trivial` shadow-stub — a STRICT §0a + §1a review failure — and even the shadowed library fallback is a §3b-cond self-assuming projection (`exact ctx.left_inverse`) that assumes the bijection it claims to prove. The qa.json already records self-assuming/proof-statement-integrity/lean-vacuity, so the formal artifact discharges nothing of the four-step Bloch–Suslin chain. Hyperbolicity holds for the figure-eight anchor (D(z)≠0, so the dilog illustration is not refuted), but the per-Bring-natural-F generalisation is over-broad and the citations mis-date Suslin/Bloch. The keystone conjecture is NOT discharged at the formal level.
